verdict.rationale: Cognee documents an official MCP server, Cognee MCP, that brings persistent memory to MCP-compatible assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue and Codex, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. The evidence is overview-level only. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the exposed MCP tools and setup/transport options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Cognee to MCP-compatible AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and Cline.
Cognee MCP brings persistent AI memory to your workflow through the Model Context Protocol.
You access them through MCP-compatible AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Desktop, Continue, Cline, and Codex.
